families.description: Connection pool maxed out under load, causing new requests to queue or fail
symptom_phrasings: checkout-service p99 latency spiking, seems to correlate with inventory-service
requests to inventory-service hanging, no error, just slow
getting intermittent 500s on inventory-service under peak traffic
db-primary showing connection refused errors sporadically
inventory-service throwing 'pool timeout' errors in logs

families.description: A downstream dependency (payment-gateway) is slow, causing cascading timeouts upstream
symptom_phrasings: checkout-service failing with gateway timeout errors
payment-gateway response times way up since this morning
orders stuck in pending state, no completion confirmation
checkout-service circuit breaker tripping repeatedly
customers reporting checkout hangs for 30+ seconds

families.description: Gradual memory growth in a service leading to OOM kills and restarts
symptom_phrasings: notification-service pod restarting every few hours
memory usage on notification-service climbing steadily, never drops
OOMKilled events showing up for notification-service
notifications delayed, seems worse the longer the service has been up

families.description: Cache expiry causes a burst of simultaneous requests to hit the DB directly
symptom_phrasings: sudden DB CPU spike every hour, on the hour
checkout-service latency briefly spikes then recovers, repeating pattern
db-primary load spikes correlate with cache TTL expiry
periodic short bursts of 5xx errors, self-resolving within a minute

families.description: A deploy shipped with a misconfigured environment variable or feature flag
symptom_phrasings: auth-service login failures spiking right after deploy
users getting logged out unexpectedly since this afternoon's release
auth-service throwing config validation errors on startup
token verification failing intermittently post-deploy

families.description: An overly aggressive rate limit was deployed, blocking legitimate traffic
symptom_phrasings: legitimate payment requests getting 429 errors
payment-gateway throttling way more traffic than expected
spike in 'rate limit exceeded' errors since last deploy
some customers can't complete payment, others unaffected

distractors.note: Wording overlaps with downstream_api_timeout family but root cause is different — DNS resolution issue, not a slow dependency
distractors.symptom_phrasing: checkout-service failing to reach payment-gateway intermittently

distractors.note: Wording overlaps with memory_leak family but root cause is a genuine traffic spike, not a leak
distractors.symptom_phrasing: notification-service under heavy load, restarting under pressure

novel_incident.note: No family — should trigger the guardrail 'no confident match' path
novel_incident.symptom_phrasing: auth-service SSL handshake failures with an external identity provider, first time this has happened
